subject: health
concept: Understanding that moving your body every day feels good and helps you grow strong
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student tries a few different kinds of movement (running, stretching, dancing) and reflects on how each feels
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a movement activity to a body benefit it provides (strong muscles, happy mood)
exercise.abstract: Student names a way they like to move their body and explains how it makes them feel

misconception_flags: frames movement/exercise only in terms of appearance or weight rather than strength, health, and enjoyment

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
